definition: The question asks whether a situation that can be impossible is actually impossible; the impossible titles mean contradicting something necessary. Conditional affirmative-report content is separate from actual assent and from any derivation of necessity of possibility.
note: This narrow input does not include A2C2’s explicit contraposition/duality argument.
